subject.title: [Bug]: Subagent completion is tagged sourceChannel=webchat in a Telegram parent, causing intermittent message gaps

question: Does an independently rebuilt v2026.7.1 package reproduce the published tarball’s `webchat` fallback, or should the existing npm release be treated as a stale-artifact defect requiring a corrected release?
rationale: The tagged source already expresses the intended invariant, so choosing between a release rebuild/hotfix and a separate runtime code repair requires authoritative release-pipeline evidence.

options.title: Verify and hotfix the artifact
options.body: Byte-compare a clean build from 2d2ddc43 with the published tarball and publish a corrected release if the npm artifact contains stale output.

options.title: Trace an alternate runtime path
options.body: If a clean release build still emits `webchat`, locate and repair the additional bundle or generated path before publishing the next stable release.

recommendation.title: Verify and hotfix the artifact
recommendation.body: Byte-compare a clean build from 2d2ddc43 with the published tarball and publish a corrected release if the npm artifact contains stale output.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this contributor to both subagent completion behavior and release-adjacent session delivery changes.
